changelog:
- Zero-Ad Social Architecture: Surgical ad suppression across Reddit (GraphQL & ad-posts), X/Twitter (promoted tweets & trends), and Instagram (sponsored feed & reels).
- YouTube Zero-Delay Engine: Strips adPlacements cleanly at manifest and fetch level (uBlock Origin standard), eliminating the 5-10s buffering timeout for instant playback startup.
- Clean, Manipulation-Free Standard: Zero video speed/seek tampering; 100% compliant and stable.
- Clean Android System WebView v2.1.7 release (17.4 MB).
